title: seek suzune recognition and reprioritize respect
context: Year 1 V5 actor goals and plans viewed through source-scoped temporal knowledge; normative evolution not automatic.
observed_actions: Trains intensely while romantically attracted to Suzune, initially stakes use of her given name on first-year MVP, and reveals his need to be noticed beyond basketball. Her direct recognition prompts a decision to return.
observed_result: He misses MVP yet receives permission to address her by her given name, and accepts a condition to avoid unjustified violence.
epistemic_limits: His romantic feelings are not reciprocally confirmed and his promise is not evidence of durable behavior or a forced motivation state after timeline divergence.
information_available: Private intent, public action and later retrospective statements stay in separate temporal lanes.
counterfactual_test: Under alternate incentives, trust and history, goal reprioritization is contingent, never pre-scripted.
